_comment: Question set for the answer quality evaluation (npm run eval:answers).
type: covered / not_covered / wrong_subject / off_topic (same meaning as retrieval-golden.json).
keyPoints: groups of phrases a good answer should contain. A group is met when the answer
contains ANY phrase in it (case-insensitive). Used for the automatic key-point score.
expectRedirect: for wrong_subject, the subject the teacher should send the student to.
